$comment: The processor's feature area map and the folders under 'specification/base/typespec' describe
the same taxonomy from two directions, and a test asserts they agree. Neither is subordinate to
the other: the folders are what the SDK is organized around, and the area map is what the
snapshot and the change report speak in. They are expected to move together.
A folder listed here is one the snapshot deliberately does not mirror. Adding an entry is how an
intentional divergence is declared, so that the check keeps catching the accidental kind. Each
entry needs a reason, because the point of the list is to record why, not merely to silence a

typeSpecFoldersWithoutFeatureArea.reason: The legacy completions API is excluded from the snapshot by decision. It is superseded by chat completions and responses, and mirroring it would imply an intent to track it.
Shared streaming constructs rather than a REST surface of its own. It owns no paths, so there is nothing for the split to assign to it.
